description: Open the dataset '~/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv' in Jamovi. In the Variable Editor (Data tab), configure the 'gender' variable: change its Measure Type to 'Nominal' and apply labels to the levels (1 = 'Male', 2 = 'Female'). Also ensure the personality items 'A1' through 'A5' are set to 'Continuous' measure type. Finally, run an Independent Samples T-Test with 'A1' as the Dependent Variable and 'gender' as the Grouping Variable to verify the labels appear in the results. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/BFI_Metadata.omv'.
